summary: Civeo Corp filed an 8-K reporting two items: a press release about a six-year contract renewal in Western Canada for workforce accommodations (Item 7.01, Regulation FD) and the pricing of a $100 million 4.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private transaction (Item 8.01, Other Events). The contract renewal is a routine operational update, not a special situation. The note offering is a debt financing, not a transformative corporate event. Neither item constitutes an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The filing is a standard current report with no special-situation trigger.
